newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids down.

text.p: Elevator bids for spring wheat were lower in the northern wheat belt, largely the result of lower Minneapolis spring wheat futures, grain dealers said.

Grain marketings were light, with most farmers concentrating on finishing wheat planting or applying fertilizers. In the Red River Valley, rain would be beneficial to soften crusted topsoil and aid crop development.
Dryness also was a concern in parts of Montana where farmers were finishing up spring wheat planting.
One Montana merchandiser said spring wheat plantings should be completed by next week.
"We're going to be up to 90 or 95 percent done this week," the merchant said. "We're dodging a few rain clouds here and there but by next week we should get things pretty much wrapped up."
